Commandant S.V.C.

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）

C. I. D.
I. 6. REG
No. 19
Date 19-1-16

January 19th 1916

Sir,
The Arsenal Authorities have collected all the warrant cards in possession of detectives under their control, and new cards of another pattern will be issued to them as soon as they furnish shop security for their good behaviour.
The operatives in the Arsenal are working day and night making machine guns for use against the Yunnan rebels.
It is reported that several of the rebels here have gone to Yunnan and that more intend to follow.
At 2 p.m. 18th instant the Nanwei Magistrate went to Tangg Kuang Zah 湯光乍 (?) Pootung in order to hold an inquiry into the trouble that took place there on 16th inst. Owing to the country people collecting and assuming a hostile attitude the Magistrate had to retire before he had completed the inquiry.

Your Obedient Servant,

M.M. Macmaster

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Endorsed Jan 19.
Seen by A.C.P.

使用完毕后，请将本卷宗归还至
中央登记处

义勇军指挥官

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））

刑事侦缉处
I. 6. 登记
第 19 号
日期 19-1-16

1916年1月19日

先生：

兵工厂当局已收回其管辖下所有侦探持有的委任证，待这些侦探提供店铺担保以保证其行为端正后，将向他们签发另一种式样的新证件。

兵工厂的工人们正日夜赶工，制造用于对抗云南叛军的机枪。

据报，此地的几名叛军分子已前往云南，且有更多人打算随后前往。

本月18日下午2时，南汇知县前往浦东汤光乍（音译），就本月16日在该地发生的骚乱事件进行调查。由于乡民聚集并采取敌对态度，知县在调查完成前被迫撤离。

您顺从的仆人，

M.M. Macmaster

总探长。

警务处总监。

批注：1月19日。
助理警务总监阅。
